name: @uigf/mihoyo-api-sdk
description: Unified TypeSpec descriptions for public MiHoYo, MiYouShe, HoYoLAB and HoYoverse HTTP APIs.

scripts.build: npm run build:spec && npm run build:runtime
scripts.build:spec: tsp compile . --output-dir generated && node tools/annotate-openapi.mjs generated
scripts.test: npm run build:runtime && node --test dist/ds.test.js && npm run test:emitter
scripts.test:emitter: npm run build:spec && node tools/verify-ds-openapi.mjs generated
